subject: Commit tiers & billing model — proposal and next steps
messages:
From: Emily Lee <emily.lee@nebulahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Clarify commit tiers & overage terms

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and I are pulling together an internal cost model and need clearer numbers for Redwood's annual commit tiers and how discounts scale by volume. A few specific questions: 

- Can you confirm per-token list price and the effective per-token price at Starter / Growth / Enterprise commit bands?
- How do overages work if we exceed the annual commit? Is there an overage rate or true-up?
- Do unused committed tokens carry over between years (or is there a refund)?
- Billing cadence: monthly against committed amount or billed as-used?

We want a short one-pager that I can share with finance and procurement. Can you send an SPDX/summary and a sample annual commit table?

Best,
Emily Lee
Program Manager, AI Platform
Nebula Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Lee <emily.lee@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarify commit tiers & overage terms

Hi Emily — great to hear from you.

Attached are two artifacts: a short proposal PDF (Redwood_Commit_Proposal_20251103.pdf) and a worksheet with the commit table (Nebula_Commit_Table_20251103.xlsx). High level summary below so you can share quickly with finance/procurement.

Summary (annual commit tiers, committed tokens + effective per-token):
- Starter: 50M tokens / year — $0.00060 per token (15% off list)
- Growth: 500M tokens / year — $0.00045 per token (40% off list)
- Enterprise: 5B tokens / year — $0.00030 per token (60% off list)

Notes on pricing mechanics and billing: 
- List price: $0.00070 per token for Hosted API text generation baseline. Discounts scale by committed annual token volume per table attached.
- Billing cadence: monthly invoices. We invoice committed amount pro rata monthly; usage is reconciled quarterly with a year-end true-up.
- Overages: usage beyond the committed annual amount is billed at 1.25x the effective per-token price (so overage is not charged at list price but higher than committed price).
- Carryover: up to 10% of unused committed tokens may be carried into the next 12 months (one-time carryforward), any remaining unused tokens are forfeited.
- True-up: at year-end we reconcile total usage vs. committed tokens — if usage exceeds commit, overage billing applies; if usage is below commit, no cash refund (credit or carryover as above).
- Contract flexibility: We can allow a single mid-year bump to the commit with prorated pricing if you want to increase capacity.

Next steps: happy to schedule a 30-min call with procurement to walk the worksheet. If useful, we can produce a draft SOW + PO-ready summary for legal.

Attaching: Redwood_Commit_Proposal_20251103.pdf (1-page), Nebula_Commit_Table_20251103.xlsx (breakdown by month/quarter).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Clarify commit tiers & overage terms (internal)

Marissa / Rishi — quick internal note before we lock numbers for Nebula:

- I’m comfortable with the tier breakpoints. For competitive motion, approve a one-time first-year promotional increase of 5% additional off the effective per-token price for Growth and Enterprise only (to help close this quarter).
- Keep Starter pricing as-is; we can offer a $10K onboarding credit instead.
- On overages: cap the first-year overage multiple at 1.20x for deals >= Growth if they sign before 11/14; afterwards revert to 1.25x. This is time-limited.
- Carryover: allow the 10% carryover but no cash refunds. Add a clause that customer may request a one-time mid-year addendum to increase commit.

Rishi — can you confirm the billing language we should put in the SOW (monthly invoicing, year-end reconciliation, PO references)?

Thanks,
Lauren
VP Sales — Americas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Lee <emily.lee@nebulahealth.com>, procurement@nebulahealth.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Updated proposal: Growth commit concession & DocuSign

Hi Emily — following up with an updated, signable summary. Per our internal alignment:

Updated offer for Nebula Health (valid until 11/14/2025):
- Growth commit: 500M tokens/year — $0.0004275 per token (45% off list; includes a one-time 5% promotional concession)
- Enterprise commit: 5B tokens/year — $0.000285 per token (59.5% off list; includes concession)
- Starter unchanged: 50M tokens/year — $0.00060 per token

Overage & billing updates:
- First-year overage cap: for Growth/Enterprise deals signed by 11/14/2025, the overage rate is capped at 1.20x the committed per-token price.
- Billing: monthly invoicing against committed amount, usage reported monthly, year-end reconciliation with any overage invoiced in the month following year-end.
- Carryover: up to 10% of unused committed tokens may be carried forward one time. No cash refunds.

Attachments: revised PDF and the commit table (same filenames). I’ve started a DocuSign envelope for the SOW/Order Form: https://www.docusign.com/envelopes/ZZZ-Envelope-Id-9988

If that looks good, I can send the DocuSign to your procurement/legal contacts and include a PO-ready summary for finance.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if you want to run numbers in front of stakeholders.

Best,
Marissa

From: Emily Lee <emily.lee@nebulahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nebulahealth.com, legal@nebulahealth.com
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Updated proposal: Growth commit concession & DocuSign

Marissa — thanks, this is exactly what we needed. Procurement and finance reviewed the worksheet and we’re comfortable with Growth at the concessioned rate. A couple of small asks before routing to legal for signature: 

- Can you add an explicit cap on first-year overage volume billing (suggested cap = 20% of committed tokens for the first year)? We want to avoid unexpected multi-x overage bills in a launch month.
- Please include PO number placeholder on the Order Form and confirm net-30 payment terms.

We have attached a signed PO stub for internal routing (Signed_PO_Nebula_20251105.pdf). If you can incorporate the cap and send the DocuSign packet to legal@nebulahealth.com, we’ll push this through our e-signature process.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get going.

Best,
Emily Lee
Program Manager, AI Platform
Nebula Health
